d:
The Lakers defeated the Kings, 106-104 tonight in Los Angeles. Luka Dončić finished with a team-high 25 points along with 8 assists and 4 rebounds for the Lakers, while Walker Kessler tallied 15 points, 7 rebounds and 2 assists in the game. De'Andre Hunter recorded 30 points, 6 rebounds and 5 three pointers. The Lakers improve their record to 14-3 with the win, while the Kings fall to 1-14 for the season.
